title: Executive KPI Briefing Copilot
outcome: Monday account brief drafted from one governed dataset, every sentence traced to a number.
summary: Leadership had dashboards but not the story, and analysts wrote the weekly account brief by hand. Built a variance engine with materiality ranking over a Power BI semantic model and an agent that drafts the brief, slide outline and Teams post for analyst approval.
cv: Inspired by: executive Power BI dashboards consolidating the top six global customers into a single KPI view, and governed single-source datasets replacing fragmented reporting.

cards.title: Dashboard to story
cards.caption: Six fictional top customers over 26 weeks: KPI tiles, hand-built sparklines with the eight-week baseline window, and only the variances that pass both threshold and z-score gates.
cards.alt: Weekly view with portfolio KPI tiles and customer sparklines for week 2026-W39

cards.title: Architecture
cards.caption: A certified Power BI semantic model feeds a Monday Power Automate flow. Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot draft in Word, PowerPoint and Teams; an analyst approves before release.
cards.alt: Architecture from Power BI semantic model through Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio to Word, PowerPoint and an approved Teams post

cards.title: Why did margin move?
cards.caption: The agent splits a margin change into a rate effect and a cost effect from pooled revenue and cost per shipment. For the seeded Fabrikam Steel dip it points to cost to serve.
cards.alt: Variance table, Word-style brief and the agent explaining a margin drop for Fabrikam Steel in 2026-W32

cards.title: No claim without data
cards.caption: Every sentence carries fact refs. The validator rejects a sentence with no source, an unknown source, or any number that is not in its referenced facts.

cards.title: Result on synthetic data
cards.caption: Computed by src/briefing.py over 18 briefed weeks. All three seeded events ranked first in their weeks; no quiet week raised a High flag.

cards.title: Slides and approval
cards.caption: The same facts produce a five-slide outline for PowerPoint and a Teams post that is only released after an analyst approves.
cards.alt: Five-slide outline cards and the agent confirming analyst approval for 2026-W35

cards.title: GitHub Copilot ready
cards.caption: Code drafted with AI pair programming and verified by 17 pytest tests, including a check that every sentence in the brief traces to a number. The repo ships GitHub Copilot custom instructions (brand, British English, synthetic data only, tests first), so every follow-up change in Copilot Chat or agent mode works to the same rules.

cards.title: Try it
cards.caption: Pick a week, click a source tag to see its DAX measure, ask why margin moved, build the slide outline and approve the Teams post.
